title: Aureline M5 generated-project-diff-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the generated-project-diff-card family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A generated-project diff card names what a starter wrote versus what the user owns and its diff-review state so a card never blurs the generated-versus-user-owned boundary and never overwrites or deletes user-owned work silently. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
